items.text: Always read the changelog before upgrading.

items.title: Three habits for safer agent repos
items.text: Most agent mishaps start with a leaked token. Always keep keys out of the repository and in a secrets store. Check every new dependency before an agent installs it. Small reviews beat big ones.

items.title: Why small pull requests merge faster
items.text: Teams that never let a pull request grow past a few hundred lines see faster reviews.
